Quick heads-up: the BS-2 you're looking at is sold out right now, and so is the BS-4.

If you want the best value we sell, it's the Harlo B30: 30 TH/s at about 360 to 450W, $899, ships October 30, 2026. The Magic Miner 40T is $799 for 40 TH/s, ships November 14, 2026, cheapest per TH in the lineup.

Both are pre-sale. Where will it run, and what's your budget? If noise or heat in a living space matters, tell me and I'll steer accordingly.
Is the BS-4 going to be stocked again?
Handed to the team · No BS-4 restock listed on the shipment status page, cannot confirm whether anoth

Honest answer: there's no BS-4 restock listed as on its way right now, so I can't promise one or give you a date. I've asked Georges to confirm whether another run is coming. The team picks that up Monday at 10am ET and the answer goes to your email, so drop me the address you'd like it sent to.

If you don't want to wait on a maybe, the Harlo B30 is 30 TH/s for $899 and ships October 30, 2026.

Got it, (email hidden) is on the note. Georges picks it up Monday at 10am ET and the BS-4 answer comes to that address.

Meanwhile, if you tell me where it'll run and your budget, I can tell you honestly whether the B30 or the Magic Miner 40T beats waiting on the BS-4.
